I work at the [California Air Resources Board](https://ww2.arb.ca.gov/). In 2021 I graduated from UC Berkeley School of Public Health with a Master’s in global health and environment. In 2017 I got my environmental science BS with a software engineering minor from Rochester Institute of Technology.
